Upstream README identifies an Asphyxia base and Pandora-derived features.

Adapted October 22, 2026 into src/features/movement/movement_steering.cpp:
- Preserve atan2(15, horizontal speed), 0..45-degree ideal-angle clamp,
  >80 speed correction branches, >170-degree branch and sequence parity.
- Initial port preserved default autostrafe_smooth=99 (correction=0.04*ideal).
  Subsequently tuned to 50 at the user's request (correction=2*ideal).
- Camera-relative WASD/diagonals use existing physical-key arbitration.
- Fix the reference W-only zero-offset early return; release remains neutral.
- Use the supplied command sequence, no global command-ring access or static keys.
- Convert rotation to the verified native positive-left analog convention.
- Publish one wish at time zero for the full command, replacing the prior
  eight-slice steering solver. Retain replay capacity for safe event retirement.
- Keep live-physics prediction, lifecycle reset and existing ownership/handoff.
- Do not port reference engine structures, offsets, movement fix, bhop or UI.

This is an adapted algorithm, not a byte-for-byte copy or a claim that the
reference's full movement implementation works on the installed client.
